body:
**VEGAS (October 14, 2026)** – The Tahoe Knight Monsters, proud ECHL affiliate of the NHL’s Vegas Golden Knights and the AHL’s Henderson Silver Knights, announced Wednesday they have extended their affiliation through the 2027-28 season, with an option to extend through 2028-29.

“We are excited to continue our great affiliation with the Vegas Golden Knights,” Knight Monsters co-owner **David Hodges** said. “We are very fortunate to continue to work with a championship-caliber organization and keep the Knight Monsters player pipeline in the state of Nevada.”

The Knight Monsters begin their third season under the Golden Knights affiliation on Saturday, October 17, as they travel to take on the Wichita Thunder. Puck drop is set for 4:05 p.m. PT, with pregame coverage on the Knight Monsters broadcast network starting at 3:50 p.m. PT.

“The Knight Monsters have proven to be a great addition to our organization and the state of Nevada over the past two seasons,” Golden Knights General Manager **Kelly McCrimmon** said. “We are extremely pleased to continue working with Tahoe to prioritize the development of our prospects as well as the growth of hockey."

The Knight Monsters open their 2026-27 home schedule on Friday, October 23, as they take on the New Mexico Goatheads at Tahoe Blue Event Center. Season tickets and ticket packages for 2026-27 are now available. **ABOUT THE VEGAS GOLDEN KNIGHTS**  
The Vegas Golden Knights are a National Hockey League franchise owned and operated by Black Knight Sports and Entertainment LLC. Established by Owner and Chairman Bill Foley and his family, the Golden Knights were the most successful expansion franchise in North American professional sports history in 2017-18 and won the Stanley Cup in 2022-23.
